title: DefinitionVerdictContribution
description: Post payload of a Contribution posted onto the Definition panel with slot = Verdict. Per-identity granularity / consolidation verdict, posted by a TOP_DOWN GranularityKS that reads the populated Statement and decides whether to keep the identity, drop it, split it, or merge it with another identity. Wave 9: replaces the dropped Granularity panel; the verdict is now a slot on Definition (the panel whose identity it adjusts), surfacing the structural fact that granularity is a property OF an identity rather than its own DAG node. Precedence rule (Definition.Merge vs Definition.Verdict.mergeWith): Verdict.mergeWith is informed by the populated Statement and wins over the earlier identity-time Definition.Merge for the same identity.

targetIdentityKeys.description: Required for splitInto / mergeWith verdicts. For mergeWith: exactly one surviving identity. For splitInto: the new identities to spawn (each yields a fresh Definition + downstream re-fire).

policyRef.description: Optional reference to the granularity-policy rule that drove this verdict (echoed from RunConfig.granularityPolicy for audit).
